data.name: Hunters Trial : One Breath
data.detailed_description:
One position. One breath. One shot.

Hunters Trial: One Breath is a fixed-position, scope-only hunting game built around stillness and timing. You never

walk and you never chase. Rooted to a single vantage point, you pan a 90° view across the wild, read each animal's

behavior, hold your breath to steady the crosshair, and squeeze off one clean shot at the perfect moment.

How it plays

  • Stationary marksman gameplay — no movement, pure aim, patience, and timing.

  • Hold your breath to steady the scope, and trigger slow-motion to thread a shot through a bolting herd.

  • Multi-zoom scope with a realistic aim-down-sights transition, reloading, and weapon handling.

  • Read the wild: passive animals graze and flee when startled, while aggressive predators charge straight at you — drop them before they reach you, or you take damage and fail.

  • Weather and conditions (clear skies, fog, and more) change visibility and difficulty on every hunt.

A full campaign

  • 40 hand-built levels across three distinct biomes: forest, savanna, and mountain.

  • Varied objectives — clear every animal, reach a kill count, survive a charging wave, hunt a specific species, or protect a marked animal where hitting the wrong target fails the trial.

  • Six difficulty tiers from Rookie to Legend, ending in a final Boss hunt. Later trials demand no-miss runs, no damage taken, headshots, and one-shot kills.

Progress and mastery

  • Earn money to unlock and buy 8 distinct scoped rifles, each with its own zoom, handling, and power.

  • Spend XP on hunter upgrades — steadier breath, faster handling, and more — all the way to the Master Hunter rank.

  • Every level is scored 1 to 3 stars on accuracy and clean shooting, with combo bonuses for back-to-back hits. Replay to perfect your score and fully clear the trials.

  • 25 Steam Achievements to hunt down.

At a glance

  • Genre: arcade hunting / fixed-position marksman

  • Single-player

  • Playable with mouse and keyboard or a controller

  • Roughly 2 to 3 hours for a first clear, more to master every star and achievement

  • No story mode, no co-op, no online — just you, your breath, and the shot you were waiting for.

Just you, your breath, and the shot you were waiting for.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 6GB / RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: i5-10400 / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 / RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Hunters Trial: One Breath features mild blood effects when animals are hunted. There is no excessive gore, and the environment is never graphically bloody.
